card.name: "Observed closely for" in suicidality warning
card.fires_on: The word "for" right after "monitored appropriately and observed closely" in the antidepressant boxed warning about suicidality. It comes just before "clinical worsening, suicidality, or unusual changes in behavior".

modes.label: Antidepressant warning
modes.description: "for" after "observed closely" in the standard warning about suicide risk in patients starting antidepressants.
modes.example: Patients of all ages who are started on antidepressant therapy should be monitored appropriately and observed closely<< for>> clinical worsening, suicidality, or

card.plain: It marks the word "for" in the standard antidepressant warning to watch patients closely for worsening or suicidal thoughts.
